responsibility: Declares the gcov binary file format constants and the shared API for reading and writing coverage files. It documents gcno/gcda record structure, defines magic numbers, version/tag/counter encodings, counter enums generated from gcov-counter.def, summary structures, and public gcov I/O entry points such as gcov_open, gcov_read_counter, gcov_write_tag, and gcov_sync. This header is the canonical format and interface definition for GCC’s coverage/profile file ecosystem.
same_name_distinction: This header is the canonical definition of the gcov file format and public I/O interface: magic values, tags, counter numbering, summary structs, and function prototypes used across compiler, gcov, gcov-tool, and libgcov. Unlike gcc/gcov-io.cc, it documents and declares the format instead of implementing file access and record encoding/decoding.
